notes: Numbers computed from run 2026-10-18T144956Z. The BLS PPI and CPI series carry September 2026. Prose drafted 2026-10-18 by a session from numbers.md at the editor's instruction, as CLAUDE.md now allows; tools/check.py passes at 95 figures, so no figure in the text is absent from numbers.json. Awaiting the editor's read and reviewer line before publication. This is the first issue of this title and the first under the gate in FA-D-20260923-01 as amended by -02, which Lobster Monitor Issue 1 opened on 2026-10-18. One correction is recorded here because it changed the computed set: tools/issue.py built its series map from the named run alone, so the two sources that state one period per report, the Dairy Market News CME reprint and shell egg report 2848, could carry no comparison at all and the weeks this record had accumulated were unreachable. Both are now declared accumulates in sources.json, the record holds five weeks of each, and the shell egg markets carry trailing four-week averages. It is described in PROVENANCE.md. Known limits of this issue. Neither the CME butter reprint nor the shell egg markets carries a year-over-year figure yet, the record holding five weeks of each; they will when it holds a year. Report 2848 publishes Large white quotations for seven markets and this issue computes three, chosen as a national, a producer-level and a Northeast reading; the issue says so. The NASS layer and table-egg-production figures are for 2026-08, the newest month published, and the record holds no 2024-08 reading, so neither carries a two-year comparison. The USDA ERS year-over-year attributes are August 2025 to August 2026, and its forecast intervals are for the calendar 2027 average against 2026, by category rather than for butter alone. Month-to-month movement is not in this issue's computed set. The weekly Egg Markets Overview is retained and not parsed, so it contributes no figure. The verification gate does not read bare counts or worded quantities in prose; those were checked by hand against the record, and that check is what caught a draft sentence implying report 2848 covers three markets.
